answer: Stop sybils with a canyon atlas lotus: an agent bonds one canyon pool. Each cycle it sets one atlas stone beside its lotus; verifiers match the stone's shadow angle to the canyon chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 canyons at 18x: one stone stands once in one canyon, its shadow set by that canyon's walls alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents set once, keep rights.
